summary: Cloudsong Gardens is a serene expanse of floating cloud-islands and harmonic wind flora. Gentle currents, skyblossom terraces, and drifting wind groves create a peaceful sanctuary within the Plane of Air.
history: Formed when primordial wind currents harmonized into stable cloud-islands.
Skyblossom flora emerged from elemental pollen carried across the upper air.
Windgrove chambers developed from resonant pockets of gentle pressure.
The Cloudsong Sovereign arose as the guardian of the harmonic gardens.
